mistakes.text: She managed staying completely still until the dragonfly settled.
mistakes.normalized: she managed staying completely still until the dragonfly settled
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „manage“ vždy patrí Infinitive s „to“: „managed to stay“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „manage“ vždy následuje Infinitive s „to“: „managed to stay“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Manage” is always followed by the Infinitive with “to”: “managed to stay”.

mistakes.text: She managed stay completely still until the dragonfly settled.
mistakes.normalized: she managed stay completely still until the dragonfly settled
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „manage“ vždy patrí Infinitive s „to“: „managed to stay“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „manage“ vždy následuje Infinitive s „to“: „managed to stay“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Manage” is always followed by the Infinitive with “to”: “managed to stay”.

mistakes.text: She managed to stay completely still until the dragonfly didn't settle.
mistakes.normalized: she managed to stay completely still until the dragonfly didn't settle
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „until“ nepatrí zápor: „until the dragonfly settled“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „until“ nepatří zápor, i když čeština ho má: „until the dragonfly settled“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't use a negative after “until”: “until the dragonfly settled”.

mistakes.text: She managed to stay completely still until the dragonfly hadn't settled.
mistakes.normalized: she managed to stay completely still until the dragonfly hadn't settled
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „until“ nepatrí zápor: „until the dragonfly settled“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „until“ nepatří zápor, i když čeština ho má: „until the dragonfly settled“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't use a negative after “until”: “until the dragonfly settled”.

mistakes.text: She managed to stayed completely still until the dragonfly settled.
mistakes.normalized: she managed to stayed completely still until the dragonfly settled
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „to“ patrí holý tvar slovesa: „to stay“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „to“ následuje holý tvar slovesa: „to stay“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “to” use the bare verb: “to stay”.

mistakes.text: She succeeded to stay completely still until the dragonfly settled.
mistakes.normalized: she succeeded to stay completely still until the dragonfly settled
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „succeed“ nemôže stáť „to“; „podarilo sa“ je tu „managed to stay“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „succeed“ nemůže stát „to“; „podařilo se“ je tu „managed to stay“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Succeed” isn't followed by “to”; here “managed to stay” is the natural choice.

mistakes.text: She was able to stay completely still until the dragonfly settled.
mistakes.normalized: she was able to stay completely still until the dragonfly settled
mistakes.feedback_en: “Managed to” is the most natural way to show she succeeded with some effort.
